experiment: isolated staged profit exits; paper simulation only
assumptions: Uses only the existing six 30-day cache files; no network requests.
Reuses the original script's feature builder, signals, ranking, position sizing, and fee constants.
Sells one third at each of +1%, +2%, and +3% net price targets, with the final target selling the remainder.
Target prices account for modeled entry and exit fees.
If a candle low touches the stop active before that candle, the stop is assumed to occur before any target on that candle.
Break-even and trailing-stop changes become active only on subsequent candles.
The last open trade, if any, is marked to liquidation after estimated exit fees; it is not a completed trade.
Approximate OHLC simulation; not evidence of future profitability.
